headline: Jersey barrier and fence questions at 16 John Road tabled; land swap at 66 and 70 West Millbury Road endorsed.
summary: The 16 John Road project was tabled after an update on barriers, fencing, drainage, and site cleanup. The town's consulting engineer, Graves, will be asked for safety input, and the item may return at a later meeting. The meeting also reviewed subdivision rules and regulations, a possible drone bylaw, and ballot question seven.
decisions: Approved endorsing the plan dated 9/5/26 showing an equal land swap between 66 and 70 West Millbury Road, 6-0 on a roll call vote.
Tabled the jersey barrier and fence questions at 16 John Road until more safety information is provided.
discussion: 16 John Road barriers: Members questioned whether the jersey barriers and fence at the top of the wall were safe, whether they looked finished, and how snow removal would work.
16 John Road site cleanup: Members asked that the gravel drive, catch basins, stored materials, and parking area be cleaned up and stabilized, and that maintenance reports be filed regularly.
Subdivision rules and regulations: Staff is reviewing the rules, which have not been updated in about 20 years, and plans to meet with departments before a December draft.
Drone restriction bylaw: Members discussed whether to draft a bylaw like Westborough's after the state Attorney General reviews that town's bylaw, and whether to ask residents for input.
Ballot question seven: Staff said 677 parcels could be affected and could potentially yield 1,095 additional lots, with many limits on those numbers.

decision_evidence.quote: Okay, ah my motion is to ad- endorse the form of plan dated 9/5/26 showing an equal land swap between 66 and 70 West Millbury Road. I'll second that motion, Mike. Okay. Bob Largess, aye. Wesley Stanhope, aye. Bill Talcott, aye. Mike Hagan, aye. David Mason, aye.
All right, so we'll table this one. You hear what the board's saying, so mull it over and then, if they want to provide the safety information for review from Graves, that's fine.
